items.ref: D2 heal scripts removed
items.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 6c671dc7 'fix(cache-heal): add rewriteShellSnapshots for #710 stale PATH' (May 2026), plus 79e7bb52 'fix(cleanup): leave a breadcrumb link when sweeping old version dirs (#814, #807) (#823)' and 2965d246 'fix: normalize stale version paths after CC auto-update (#727)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: the cache-heal script existed specifically to repair stale PATH/version-dir state after CC auto-updates (#710, #727) — it is a real fix for a real recurring class of bug (stale cache after host tool auto-update), not dead code.
